text: 1. Proof of English proficiency during the validity period: IELTS/TOEFL/TOEIC transcript or equivalent level;2. Photocopy of passport photo page3. Guardian Guarantee (Please download, fill and upload online)4. Admission Commitment (Please download online, must be signed and uploaded)5. Copy of guardian's ID card or passport photo page6. Visa Page (for students studying in Chinese universities)7. Certificate of study (for students studying in Chinese universities, please upload it to other attached folders)8. Transfer certificate or dropout certificate (for students studying in Chinese universities, please upload to other attached folders)9. 2 letters of recommendation (If the applicant is a student, the letter of recommendation needs to be filled in by the school teacher)10. Recommendation letter and transcript of current university (for students studying in Chinese universities, please upload to "Other Attachments" folder)11. Transcript (Photocopy, if the text is not Chinese or English, the Chinese or English translation must be submitted at the same time)1. Graduation certificate/Pre-graduation certificate or study certificate (photocopy, if the text is not Chinese or English, Chinese or English translation must be submitted at the same time)
